title: 9 Best Herbal Teas For Gastroenteritis
description: Artemisia absinthium teas, also known as wormwood tea, have been traditionally used to treat gastroenteritis, a common ailment characterized by inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract. The properties of this herbal preparation help to treat gastroenteritis by reducing inflammation, killing bacteria, and regulating bowel movements, thereby alleviating symptoms such as diarrhea, abdominal pain, and nausea.
